method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the applicant's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (a step to be taken within the days the Act allows) run by EVALTRACE inside five exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: State Administrative Tribunal Act 2004 (WA), No. 54 of 2004, compilation to the Towing Services Act 2024 (No. 37 of 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49227.txt (committed text sha256 6f343d911b3e151db1d41e88ff9b2a9662a86875ef3d659f5c8e312dc4d07fc8), retrieved from legislation.wa.gov.au on 2026-09-07

seat: the applicant: the individual who brings a matter to the State Administrative Tribunal (a review of a decision made about them, or a claim an enabling Act sends to the Tribunal), and the individual who is a party to a Tribunal proceeding (sat-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run sat-dates.l4 ; l4 run sat-rules.l4 ; l4 run sat-seat.l4 ; l4 run sat-cases.l4
checks.result: 195 assertions written, 195 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
